knowledge_base.statement: Our data centers are located in the US Central region, specifically hosted within Google Cloud Platform. All customer data is physically stored in the USA.
knowledge_base.details: We leverage GCP for data hosting, so all data is managed within their secure data centers.

knowledge_base.statement: Yes. We monitor and restrict the installation of unauthorized software through application whitelisting and blacklisting.
knowledge_base.details: Only approved applications may be installed, and security approval is required before any freeware or shareware is introduced.

knowledge_base.statement: Yes. Business continuity and operational resilience documentation is available to authorized stakeholders.
knowledge_base.details: The documentation is reviewed and updated annually to maintain its relevance and effectiveness.

knowledge_base.statement: No. We do not have a dedicated sanctions compliance officer.
knowledge_base.details: Our internal audit and compliance department oversees regulatory issues, and our compliance program restricts activity with sanctioned countries.

knowledge_base.statement: Yes. We operate an Identity and Access Management system covering formal request, approval and provisioning of role-based access.
knowledge_base.details: Multifactor authentication is enforced and access rights are reviewed periodically.

knowledge_base.statement: Yes. Private keys are provisioned for a unique purpose and cryptographic material is treated as secret.
knowledge_base.details: Keys are generated using approved cryptographic libraries and every status change is tracked and reported.

knowledge_base.statement: All data in transit is protected using TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3.
knowledge_base.details: Standardized network protocols are used for the management, import and export of data.

knowledge_base.statement: Yes. The Incident Response Plan includes an event reporting mechanism and lists the actions required during an information security event.
knowledge_base.details: Affected customers are notified within 24 hours of incident confirmation.

knowledge_base.statement: Yes. Environmental control systems monitor and maintain on-site temperature and humidity within accepted industry standards.
knowledge_base.details: HVAC and humidity controls are tested on a regular maintenance schedule.

knowledge_base.statement: No. Our asset inventory does not include IoT devices, because we do not operate any.
knowledge_base.details: A comprehensive inventory is maintained for all physical and logical assets in use.

knowledge_base.statement: Yes. Infrastructure and virtualization security policies are established, documented, approved, communicated, applied, evaluated and maintained.
knowledge_base.details: Policies are owned by the security team and reviewed on an annual cycle.

knowledge_base.statement: Yes. Asset management and malware protection policies are reviewed and updated at least annually.
knowledge_base.details: Reviews confirm the controls remain aligned with current security practice.
